title: Charges made by a user who gained access to the service or equipment
facts_text: A person who was not authorized to use my service gained access to the account or equipment and incurred charges. I am asking whether those charges should be disputed and waived.
request: Please remove the charges made by the unauthorized user from my account.

strict.reason: The account terms state that customers must pay charges incurred on their account, including charges made by users who gain access to the service or equipment.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The exception clause allows only documented, express authorized exceptions; account-access charges are not automatically waived.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The terms impose responsibility for charges incurred on the account; ambiguity does not erase that obligation without a verified, authorized exception.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This scenario addresses account-security and billing responsibility. Authenticated account security issues may warrant separate investigation, but the policy itself places responsibility on the customer for charges incurred by users who gain access.
